purpose: Phase-7B vascular delivery-modifier combination model. Combines perfusion efficiency, vascular permeability, vessel density, and vessel-maturity delivery efficiency into a single schematic drug-DELIVERY modifier + an ordinal delivery state. The delivery modifier influences EFFECTIVE drug arrival / extracellular availability / delivery opportunity ONLY - it NEVER modifies drug chemistry, drug release, protein interactions, or gene regulation. Schematic; no absolute delivery rate.
delivery_note: delivery_modifier = clamp(weighted combination, delivery_floor, 1); 1 = unrestricted vascular delivery, lower = poorer delivery.

state_thresholds.thresholds_basis: SCHEMATIC ordinal boundaries on the combined delivery modifier [0,1]; above good_delivery = excellent_delivery. NOT measured delivery fractions.

stop_boundary: vascular delivery modifies drug availability (effective drug arrival / extracellular availability / delivery opportunity)
